note: The slice is a byte copy of the kit's files at `ref`; each sha256 is the value the kit's own digests.json records at that ref (ADR 0007 § Decision 2, 'Consumption is a pinned slice plus a parity gate'). `design/tokens/check-upstream.mjs` re-proves slice == kit at this ref == these hashes, and this repository's brand roles == the slice. A pin bump is a deliberate change: update `version`, `ref`, `commit`, the slice and these hashes together.
